description: Runs a Google Analytics 4 report (Data API runReport): metrics broken down by dimensions over date ranges, with optional filters, sorting and paging. Rows come back as objects keyed by dimension/metric name. Default: last 28 days, 100 rows. Tips: put "date" in dimensions for a time series; use order_bys + limit for top-N lists; event-scoped custom dimensions are "customEvent:<param>".

currency_code.description: ISO 4217 code, e.g. "EUR". Default: the property currency.

date_ranges.description: Up to 4 date ranges. Default: last 28 full days (28daysAgo to yesterday). Several ranges add a "dateRange" column (e.g. for period comparisons).

name.description: Optional label; shows up as the "dateRange" column when you pass several ranges.

dimension_filter.description: Filter on dimensions (applied before aggregation), e.g. [{"field": "eventName", "op": "exact", "value": "purchase"}].

case_sensitive.description: String ops and in_list only. Default false.

field.description: Dimension or metric API name, e.g. "eventName", "pagePath", "sessionDefaultChannelGroup", "sessions".

op.description: String ops: exact, contains, begins_with, ends_with, full_regex (RE2, whole value), partial_regex; in_list (uses "values"); numeric ops: eq, lt, lte, gt, gte (use a number "value"), between (uses "from"/"to"); empty (value is empty / not set).

value.description: Value to compare with (string ops and numeric ops).

any.description: At least one of these conditions must match (OR).

dimensions.description: Dimension API names, e.g. "date", "eventName", "sessionSourceMedium", "sessionDefaultChannelGroup", "pagePath", "country", "deviceCategory", "transactionId", "itemName". Full list: https://developers.google.com/analytics/devguides/reporting/data/v1/api-schema. Custom ones: get_custom_dimensions_and_metrics.

keep_empty_rows.description: Include rows whose metrics are all 0. Default false.

limit.description: Max rows to return. Default 100. The result says when more rows exist (next_offset).

metric_aggregations.description: Also return totals / maximums / minimums across all rows.

metric_filter.description: Filter on metrics (applied after aggregation), e.g. [{"field": "sessions", "op": "gt", "value": 100}].

offset.description: Row offset for paging (use next_offset from a previous result).

dimension_order.description: For dimensions only. Use numeric for e.g. "date" or "hour"-like dimensions stored as strings.

property_id.description: GA4 property ID, e.g. "123456789" or "properties/123456789" (not the G-XXXX measurement ID). get_account_summaries lists them.

return_property_quota.description: Include the property quota status in the result.
